summary: Bounded case-sensitive byte-string comparison. Scans a1 for its first null byte within an a3-byte budget to derive an effective compare length v6 = a3 - v3, then compares a2 against a1 for that many bytes, stopping at the first mismatch. Returns a normalized -1/0/1 verdict based on the final compared byte pair: -1 when the a2 tail byte is greater, 1 when smaller, 0 when equal. When a3 is zero the body is skipped and 0 is returned. Its 14 static callers include path and scene parsers (PathDirectoryExtractionAndComparison, SceneFileTopLevelParser, CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector, SpecialFX_Init), consistent with a shared path/name comparison utility.

operations.description: Load the length budget: v3 = a3.
When a3 is zero the whole body is skipped and the function returns 0.
Scan a1 for the first null byte, decrementing v3 per byte and stopping when a null is found or the budget runs out.
Effective compare length: v6 = a3 - v3, i.e. how many leading non-null bytes of a1 fit within the budget.
Compare a2 against a1 byte by byte for v6 iterations, stopping at the first mismatch.
Compare the final bytes of both strings: v9 = *(a2 - 1) against *(v7 - 1).
Return the normalized verdict: ~0 (-1) when the a2 tail byte is greater, ~(-2) (1) when smaller, 0 when equal.
Invoked as a path/name comparison by 14 static callers including PathDirectoryExtractionAndComparison, SceneFileTopLevelParser, CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector and SpecialFX_Init.
